messages:
leo: FYI AlphaHealth sent their identity/security pack. Key asks: SAML EncryptedAssertion, SCIM v2 with near-instant deltas, nested groups, delegated admin via group->role mapping, and GovCloud VPC-only deployment. Demo requested Wed. Can we support and what's the delta for Dedicated sandbox vs Hosted?
tara: Short answer: EncryptedAssertion supported (per-tenant certs). GovCloud/VPC -> Dedicated or Private. Hosted can't guarantee no public endpoints.
andre: SCIM: default delta ~30s. For near-instant we recommend webhooks + event bridge on Dedicated; can do <5s in POC. Bulk onboarding: CSV import recommended.
leo: They expect bursts ~2k users/min during initial sync. Any temporary rate bump possible?
ops-bot: Note: default SCIM rate-limit = 1 rps/token. Ops can raise to 40 rps for a timeboxed window on Dedicated with autoscale request + IP allowlist.
tara: Audit logs >=12 months -> Dedicated only; Hosted = 90 days by default (paid extension possible). KMS/HSM support available on Private/Dedicated.
andre: Nested groups -> we flatten during ingest; need sample graph + mapping CSV (group->role). We can map to delegated-admin roles.
leo: Action items: @andre draft SCIM webhook + bulk import snippet; @tara draft security pack answers mentioning certs/KMS/audit; @ops-bot confirm sandbox ETA. Demo Wed tentative.
ops-bot: Sandbox ETA: 36-48h after IP allowlist + SAML metadata + signed POA.
leo: Thanks all :thumbsup:
